# incorelab

> Independent software engineering, design, and applied AI studio based in Dubai, UAE and Zurich, Switzerland.

We build fast Next.js websites, custom Shopify stores, React Native mobile apps, and practical AI automation systems for growing companies and modern brands worldwide.

## Key Facts

- **Locations**: Dubai, UAE (Business Bay) and Zurich, Switzerland (Bahnhofstrasse)
- **Primary Website**: https://incorelab.com
- **Languages**: English and Arabic (العربية)
- **Currencies**: AED (United Arab Emirates Dirham) and USD (US Dollars)
- **Direct Contact**: hello@incorelab.com
- **WhatsApp**: +971 50 123 4567
- **Project Inquiry**: https://incorelab.com/contact

## Services

- [Next.js Web Development](https://incorelab.com/services#service-web): High-speed websites and web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and edge hosting.
- [E-Commerce & Shopify](https://incorelab.com/services#service-ecommerce): Custom Shopify themes, Shopify Plus setups, headless commerce, and high-converting checkout flows.
- [Mobile Apps](https://incorelab.com/services#service-mobile): Native-feel iOS and Android mobile apps built on React Native and Expo.
- [3D & WebGL Experiences](https://incorelab.com/services#service-3d): Interactive 3D graphics, Three.js product showcases, and interactive web tools.
- [Branding & UI/UX Design](https://incorelab.com/services#service-brand): Complete design systems in Figma, wireframing, rapid prototyping, and identity design.
- [Applied AI & Automation](https://incorelab.com/services#service-ai): Custom AI workflows, document parsing, automated lead intake, and LLM integrations that save real working hours.
- [Growth & Search Marketing](https://incorelab.com/services#service-growth): Technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Core Web Vitals, and conversion rate optimization.
- [Cloud Hosting & DevOps](https://incorelab.com/services#service-cloud): Infrastructure on Vercel, AWS, and Cloudflare with zero-downtime CI/CD and secure API integrations.

## Transparent Pricing (Dubai & International)

We publish realistic project tiers for clients in the UAE and worldwide:

- **Sprint / MVP / Focused Tool**: AED 5,000 to AED 15,000 (approx. $1,400 to $4,000 USD). Ideal for landing pages, Framer setups, and single-purpose workflow tools.
- **Custom Web Application or Shopify Store**: AED 15,000 to AED 35,000 (approx. $4,000 to $9,500 USD). Full Next.js marketing websites or custom-built Shopify stores with custom integrations.
- **Full Platform & Mobile App**: AED 35,000 to AED 75,000 (approx. $9,500 to $20,000 USD). React Native iOS and Android apps, 3D WebGL experiences, and end-to-end web platforms.
- **Enterprise Systems**: AED 75,000+ (approx. $20,000+ USD). Multi-vendor marketplaces, ERP backends, high-traffic portals, and complex corporate infrastructure.

## Case Studies & Work

- [Paynex Terminal](https://incorelab.com/work/paynex-terminal): High-frequency algorithmic trading visualization and financial terminal.
- [DriveGo Mobility](https://incorelab.com/work/drivego-mobility): Luxury car rental platform with keyless Bluetooth mobile access.
- [ProERP Enterprise Suite](https://incorelab.com/work/proerp-suite): Global cloud ERP dashboard orchestrating supply chains and automated ledgers.
- [FlowAI Intelligence](https://incorelab.com/work/flowai-automation): Autonomous multi-agent workflow pipeline powered by n8n and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
- [NEXA Architecture](https://incorelab.com/work/nexa-architecture): Monolithic architectural space translated into an editorial monograph.
- [Monolith Horology](https://incorelab.com/work/monolith-horology): Digital provenance vault and showroom for rare haute horlogerie timepieces.
- [Luxury AeroJet](https://incorelab.com/work/luxury-aerojet): On-demand private aviation booking engine with real-time ADS-B radar flight tracking.
